repairs_and_limits: Initial sparse PID 8056 found a real correctness defect: a Cell resolved to its Layer canvas but keyboard start retained global Cell selection, causing the Layer ownership fence to cancel. Admitted keyboard gestures now select their displayed target consistently across adapters. Existing UUIDs select synchronously through Golden's index; new nodes retain guarded graph-delta selection. The graph-wide selection scan was removed. Current sparse and all eight native flows pass.

The next sparse run reached the repaired Layer behavior but the fixture assumed its far grid scroll position survived a tab revisit. It now explicitly scrolls to the far address before selecting it; no product acceptance was weakened. A Cell Tab check also now waits for the handle's actual enabled/tabindex admission before traversing focus. Initial logs are retained.

Initial GPU runs used Cargo's dev profile and are functional evidence only. Before accepting this gate, both binaries were rebuilt with required --profile test and all five suites/222 images passed. Earlier dev-profile results do not count toward this qualification.
